# Broker schema-1 compatibility fixture

`broker-journal.sqlite` was produced by Broker commit
`dd2add2b9d41540521d08c77d19fb467a2d8029e`, the Broker revision pinned by
Bloom commit `9dc4039d` in `packaging/triad/release/compatibility-v1.toml`.

The fixture contains the released Broker's shared journal after its existing
authority/ceremony consolidation: one installed wallet policy, one completed
wallet-registration ceremony with its signed custody receipt, and one pending
wallet-delete ceremony. It contains generated test identities and no installed
machine data or private production material.

Generate it with:

```sh
scripts/generate-schema1-compat-fixture.sh
```

The generator checks out the exact predecessor in a temporary worktree and
runs its end-to-end authenticated RPC test with `cargo test --locked`. The
test uses fresh cryptographic randomness and timestamps, so regenerated bytes
will differ. The reviewed fixture in this tree has SHA-256:

```text
27772833a792ddcfb1d1493fa56bd6c7efdd06bcbc2b12edd749aea2dc8bb825
```
